EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
Order under Section No. 54 (3) of National Sports Association Regulations

I, Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, by virtue of the powers vested in me in terms of the National SportsAssociation Regulations laid down under Section 54 (3) in the Gazette (Extraordinary) No. 1825/ 38 dated on 30th ofAugust 2013 published under Section 41 of the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, do hereby direct Mr. Kaludura Shantha Ruwanchandrade Silva, the Director General of the Department of Sports, to convene and conduct the Election of the Judo Association toelect its new office bearers, due to the fact that the term of office of the Interim committee has expired on 15.07.2015 and thefailure to hand over the letters of delegation of powers, direct to the Director General of Department of Sports during thespecified time by Sports clubs at the election of the Sri Lanka Judo Association, and with a view to do away with perjudicalacts that may occur in the course of election and in order to seek the active contribution of all Sprots Clubs for thedevelopment of Judo.
